race.comment: TOO DARN DISCREET (1) is going very well without winning this campaign. She got home well in the G1 Toorak Handicap last start to only be beaten three lengths and her Flemington form stands out - last time she was at this track/trip she smashed Land Legend. She'll get back but should be very hard to hold out. SHOCKLETZ (3) is flying. She had blinkers off (key gear change) in the G2 Herbert Power but still charged home. This is clearly a prep run for the Melbourne Cup so tread very carefully. PERFECT TEN (9) was very good first up off a short spell behind Surfin' Bird and should be better suited at 2000m despite never running beyond 1800m. SOVERATO (13) was much better second up at a huge quote in a good race, ready to peak up in trip now and gets in with no weight for D Lane.
